sections.text: 01 The room A grown-up dance bar built like your favourite memory. Boogie Bar brings the glow of the 1980s back without the student-night chaos. Think chrome rails, deep booths, electric blue light, proper service, and a dance floor made for people who know every chorus. Neon booths Private tables for birthdays, reunions, date nights, and old friends getting the band back together.
